item.title: Blizzard completes maiden Olympics
item.description: Ararat's Sarah Blizzard has completed her first Olympics, finishing 21st in the two-woman bobsleigh.This was the first time Australia had more than one team in the event. Bree Walker and Kiara Reddingius finished 10th.Blizzard, the pilot on her team, competed with brakeman Desi Johnson.After day one, they were in 19th place.
